content_sections.heading: NHM Janjgir Champa Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: National Health Mission (NHM), District Health Society, Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh has released the NHM Janjgir Champa Recruitment 2026 Notification for 66 contractual vacancies across various healthcare, nursing, technical, administrative, and support staff posts. The recruitment includes Staff Nurse, Laboratory Technician, Radiographer, Community Health Officer (CHO), ANM, Dental Surgeon, Senior Nursing Officer, Accountant, Block Manager, Security Guard, Class IV, Cleaner, Attendant, and several other positions. Eligible candidates with qualifications ranging from 8th Pass, 10th Pass, 12th Pass, Diploma, ANM, GNM, B.Sc Nursing, Graduation, BDS/MDS, and other relevant disciplines can apply. The monthly remuneration ranges from ₹8,800 to ₹31,500, and the offline application must reach the prescribed address on or before 10 August 2026 (5:00 PM). Click Here to Download NHM Janjgir Champa Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: NHM Janjgir Champa Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The 66 vacancies are divided into two groups. Table A contains 46 vacancies across 19 posts , while Table B contains another 20 vacancies across four posts .

content_sections.heading: Which NHM Janjgir Champa Posts Can You Apply For?
content_sections.text: Instead of having one common qualification, each post has its own educational and professional requirements. Candidates should match their qualification with the relevant post before applying. Candidates who have passed Class 8 can consider the following posts, subject to other eligibility conditions: Support Staff - House Keeping Cleaner Attendant (NRC) Cook Cum Care Taker (NRC) The Class IV - UHWC post requires candidates to have passed Class 10. The Security Guard post also includes educational, physical and other eligibility requirements specified in the notification. Several posts require Class 12 along with professional or computer qualifications. For example, the Junior Secretarial Assistant-LDC-NUHM post requires 12th pass with at least a one-year Computer Diploma . Radiographer applicants require 10+2 with Science along with the prescribed Radiographer/X-Ray Technician qualification and applicable registration. For Laboratory Technician posts, candidates should possess DMLT/BMLT or the applicable Paramedical Technology qualification and meet the registration requirements specified in the notification. Applicants for ANM posts should have passed 12th and ANM training from an INC-affiliated training centre and possess live registration with the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council. For Staff Nurse posts, candidates should possess: B.Sc Nursing, or GNM qualification They should also possess valid live registration with the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council as prescribed. Applicants for Community Health Officer should possess B.Sc Nursing with Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing with Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course and valid registration with the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council. The Dental Surgeon post requires MDS with registration in Chhattisgarh Medical Council or BDS with applicable registration as mentioned in the notification. A common merit list is to be prepared according to the prescribed recruitment conditions. Candidates should have: Graduate degree with minimum 55% marks along with PGDCA, or BCA with minimum 55% marks Applicants should be Commerce Graduates and possess the prescribed experience in maintaining accounts using a double-entry system. Experience in accounting software is also required.

NHM Janjgir Champa Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for contractual recruitment is 18 years . According to the notification, the upper age limit differs according to the nature of the post. The maximum age can extend up to 70 years for medical posts and up to 64 years for managerial posts , subject to the applicable NHM and Chhattisgarh Government rules. Age is calculated with reference to 1 January 2026 .

content_sections.heading: How Candidates Will Be Selected
content_sections.text: NHM Janjgir-Champa does not use one common selection process for all 66 vacancies. The selection route depends on the post. For several professional, technical and nursing posts, marks are awarded on the basis of educational qualification, relevant experience and skill test, written examination or interview as applicable. For many posts, the selection framework includes: Marks based on qualifying educational percentage Skill Test, Written Test or Interview marks Experience marks, where applicable Certain support posts are selected primarily through a merit list prepared from the prescribed educational qualification and applicable experience marks. This route applies to posts such as: Security Guard Class IV Support Staff - House Keeping Cleaner Attendant (NRC) Cook Cum Care Taker Staff Nurse selection includes educational qualification marks along with skill test, written test or interview marks and experience marks as applicable. Candidates called for a Skill Test, Interview or Written Examination are required to obtain at least 30% of the prescribed marks in that stage. Candidates failing to secure the minimum marks may be considered ineligible for further selection.

content_sections.heading: Shortlisting for Skill Test, Written Test or Interview
content_sections.text: Where the number of applications exceeds the number that can reasonably be assessed, candidates will be shortlisted according to the number of advertised vacancies.

content_sections.heading: NHM Janjgir Champa Application Process 2026
content_sections.text: The application procedure is offline . Candidates applying for the posts covered under the regular offline application process must send the completed application form with all required self-attested documents through Registered Post or Speed Post . Applications through other methods will not be accepted for those posts. Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh The completed application for the applicable offline posts must reach the office by 10 August 2026 up to 5:00 PM . Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Special Schedule for Table B Posts
content_sections.text: The notification provides a separate scheduled process for posts shown in Table B. Candidates applying for these posts should carefully follow the separate reporting, application submission and selection instructions given against the respective post in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NHM Janjgir Champa Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee varies according to the candidate's category and the monthly remuneration of the post applied for. The fee should be paid through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of DISTRICT HEALTH SOCIETY, Non NHM Other Fund Janjgir , payable at Janjgir. The application fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and separate Demand Draft for each post.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Keep Ready
content_sections.text: Completed prescribed application form Recent passport-size photograph Class 8 marksheet for posts requiring 8th pass qualification Class 10 marksheet Class 12 marksheet, where applicable All year or semester marksheets of the required professional qualification Degree, Diploma or professional qualification certificate Computer Diploma or Degree certificate, wherever required Professional registration certificate, wherever applicable Caste certificate Chhattisgarh domicile certificate Valid identity proof Disability certificate, if applicable Experience certificate and appointment order, where experience is claimed NOC from current employer, if applicable Demand Draft for application fee Any other document required for the specific post

content_sections.heading: Contract Period
content_sections.text: The appointments are being made on a contractual basis . The notification states that the engagement will initially be valid up to 31 March 2027 . The contractual appointment may be extended depending on satisfactory performance, availability of the post, approval in the applicable ROP and other governing conditions. Contract employees will receive the fixed monthly contractual remuneration applicable to their post. Additional allowances or facilities outside those admissible under the applicable rules are not automatically payable.

content_sections.heading: Chhattisgarh Domicile Requirement
content_sections.text: The notification requires candidates to be original residents of Chhattisgarh and to submit the prescribed residence certificate issued by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Important Points Before Applying
content_sections.text: Check the exact educational qualification for the post before applying. Professional registration must be valid wherever the post requires registration. Applications containing incomplete or incorrect information can be rejected. Separate applications are required when applying for more than one post. The applicable application fee must also be paid separately for each post. Self-attested copies of the required educational and supporting documents should be enclosed. Relevant experience will be considered only when supported by acceptable experience certificates. Reservation will be provided according to applicable Chhattisgarh Government and NHM rules. Selection does not create a claim for permanent government employment. Candidates should regularly check the Janjgir-Champa district website for recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NHM Janjgir Champa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 66 contractual vacancies across healthcare, nursing, technical, administrative and support staff posts.

faq.question: Q2. Which post has the highest salary?
faq.answer: Among the posts listed in the notification, the Senior Nursing Officer - Psychiatric Nurse post carries a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 31,500.

faq.question: Q3. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 14 Staff Nurse vacancies under SNCU/NBSU/NRC.

faq.question: Q4. How many Laboratory Technician vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 12 Laboratory Technician vacancies have been notified under NHM/BPHU.

faq.question: Q5. Are there jobs for 8th pass candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. Posts such as Support Staff, Cleaner, Attendant and Cook Cum Care Taker prescribe Class 8 qualification, subject to the complete eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary under NHM Janjgir Champa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The contractual monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 8,800 to Rs. 31,500, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date for NHM Janjgir Champa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For the applicable regular offline recruitment posts, the application should reach the prescribed office by 10 August 2026 up to 5:00 PM. Table B posts follow the separate dates and process stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is NHM Janjgir Champa application online?
faq.answer: No. The recruitment follows an offline application process, with separate instructions applying to certain posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee ranges from Rs. 100 to Rs. 400 based on category and the monthly remuneration attached to the post.
